articles.summary: Warby Parker Inc. (NYSE: WRBY) (“Warby Parker” or the “Company”), a direct-to-consumer lifestyle brand focused on vision for all, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Highlights Delivered revenue of $244.7 million, up 10.4% year over year. Drove Active Customer growth of 3.0% to 2.74 million on a trailing 12-month basis, and Average Revenue per Customer of $342, up 6.7% year over year. Achieved gross margin of 54.4%, up from 54.1% in the prior year. Generated net income of $5.6 million and Adjusted EBITDA (1) of $28.6 million. articles.title: Warby Parker Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: The brand reveals all three styles in its first Intelligent EyewearTM collection, pairing signature design and prescription expertise with remarkable technology that opens up new ways to explore, learn, and discover. Warby Parker Inc. (NYSE: WRBY), a lifestyle brand focused on vision for all, today unveiled its full Intelligent Eyewear TM collection: three frame styles—Alden, Reid, and Wren—built in partnership with Google and Samsung. Available for preorder starting today, the collection starts at $395, with deliveries expected starting mid-December. Customers can explore all three styles at warbyparker.com and book an appointment to demo Intelligent Eyewear at any Warby Parker store in the U.S. Warby Parker's Intelligent Eyewear collection For more than 16 years, Warby Parker has helped people see more clearly.
